brief_description: Utilizes atomic-centered symmetry functions as descriptors. Trained from scratch using se_atten_v2, se_e2_a, se_e2_r and DPA-2 architectures.
Graph neural network incorporating global state vectors and three-body interactions. Fine-tuned from the pre-trained M3GNet-MP-2021.2.8-PES model.
Graph neural network regularized with magnetic moments derived from DFT calculations. Fine-tuned using the pre-trained "chgnet_0.3.0_e29f68s314m37.pth.tar" model based on MPtrj dataset.
